L6: # Pushing The Boundaries of Innovation Through Our Technology
L7: 
L8: Contoro is at the cutting-edge of robotics, artificial intelligence and human-machine interface.

L10: cite3†Image L11: ## InteleOp
L12: 
L13: Inteleop enables fast, safe operations of high-payload industrial robotic arms. Our teleoperation allows for seamless, reliable function without customer intervention, even when AI encounters edge cases during warehouse unloading. We also digitize and automate real-world data collection, creating a continuous learning loop for AI model training, making our solution the industry’s most reliable.
L14: ## AdaptAI
L15: 
L16: Our robots leverage advanced cameras and sensors to collect vital information about containers, including wall locations, box positions, stacking, and sizes. This data creates a virtual environment for AdaptAI, which generates hundreds of optimized, collision-free paths based on box size, location, condition, and weight.
L17: InteleOp enables robots to gather real-world edge case data, allowing for continuous, customer-specific model training that enhances reliability and accelerates AI evolution. This data also improves our foundational model, gradually reducing the need for human intervention.

L21: cite5†Image L22: ## DuoGrasp
L23: In shipping containers, the top surface of packages is often inaccessible, making front grasping essential. Traditional vacuum-based grippers, which rely on top access, struggle with front grasping, especially for long and heavy boxes. Contoro’s gripper can securely and reliably grasp the most diverse and heaviest boxes in the warehouse by grabbing two sides simultaneously—typically the front face and another accessible surface (bottom, top, or side).
L24: This approach ensures a strong hold, even when the top surface is inaccessible, overcoming a significant limitation of traditional methods.
